description: The archived original of one document, returned as a file, not text; for text use get_regulatory_document with include body. Check fileAvailability first. content_not_archived means we never held the bytes: do not retry. archive_unavailable means our archive failed: retry later. Neither means the regulator did not publish it. Cost: 1 credit.
